## Multiple Advisory Firms Initiate or Add Analog Devices (ADI) Positions in Routine 13F Filings

Routine advisory accumulation is a minor positive flow data point for ADI but carries no fundamental signal; note as background demand without altering the core thesis assessment.

- Diversify Advisory Services, Meeder Advisory Services ($6.16M), and Wealthfront Advisers ($27.58M) each disclosed new or increased ADI positions.
- All three are classified as routine quarterly 13F-style disclosures.
- No product, earnings, partnership, or analyst event is named alongside the filings.
- Aggregate disclosed accumulation is in the tens of millions — meaningful flow data but not thesis-moving.
